translations.source_sense_description: stark auf die eigene Dominanz über andere fixiert

glosses: present participle and gerund of domineer
The act of one who domineers.

examples.text: In strange contrast to the hardly tolerable constraint and nameless invisible domineerings of the captain's table, was the entire care-free license and ease, the almost frantic democracy of those inferior fellows the harpooneers.
